concerns.text: T022 (Extract grain features) and T008 (Generate Hall-Petch labels) are placed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but depend on the train/val/test split defined in T013 (Phase 3). T022 outputs `grain_features.csv` for 'every image' before the split exists, and T008 depends on T022. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule for the split manifest and risks data leakage if features are extracted on the full dataset before splitting. T022 and T008 must move to Phase 3 (US1) or Phase 4 (US2) *after* T013.

Phase 7 (Revision & Correction) contains T040-T042 which fix the critical data source contradiction (Synthetic vs. Real). These tasks are listed as 'mandatory' but are placed *after* Phase 6 (Polish) and are not integrated into the main execution flow (Phase 1-6). The data generation (T041) and download logic (T040) are prerequisites for US1 (T011-T015). Placing them in a post-polish phase creates a logical impossibility: the pipeline cannot run (Phase 3) without the data source fixes (Phase 7). These tasks must be moved to Phase 2 (Foundational) or Phase 3 (US1) to ensure the pipeline is executable.

T008 (Phase 2) implements 'Hall-Petch label generation' and depends on T022. T023 (Phase 4) implements 'physics-based baseline (Hall-Petch predictor)' and also depends on T022. T008 appears to generate the *labels* for training, while T023 generates the *baseline predictor* for evaluation. However, T008 is in Phase 2 (Foundational) which blocks all stories, while T023 is in US2. If T008 generates the ground truth labels, it must precede US2 training. If T008 is the baseline predictor, it is misplaced. The dependency chain is ambiguous: T008 (Phase 2) -> T023 (Phase 4) is valid, but T008's placement in 'Foundational' implies it is a generic utility, yet it is tagged [US2]. This creates a semantic ordering conflict regarding when the labels are generated vs. when the baseline is trained.

T022 is tagged [US2] but placed in Phase 2 (Foundational). While the task content (feature extraction) is foundational, the [US2] tag implies it belongs to User Story 2. If it is truly foundational (needed for US1, US2, US3), it should be untagged or tagged [Shared]. If it is only for US2, it should be moved to Phase 4. The current placement breaks the 'User Story groups' independence rule.
